answer: Anchor every agent identity to a staked vertex in a public trust graph: joining requires a refundable deposit plus a vouch from an existing member whose own stake is slashed if the newcomer cheats. New identities start with a willow-thin reputation that only thickens through months of verified work, so a Sybil operator must fund and age thousands of deposits at once. Victims are reimbursed from an ocean-wide shared insurance pool funded by small fees, making mass fakery cost far more than any gain it could bring.
